fault_scenarios.description: A) WP suddenly switches to false (spontaneous sensor failure - MPA is no longer detected despite not moving) B) WP never becomes true (MPA is not recognized at working position after movement)

A) IP suddenly switches to false (spontaneous sensor failure - MPA is no longer detected at initial position despite not moving) B) IP never becomes true (MPA is not recognized at initial position after movement)
WP incorrectly remains true even after movement, while IP becomes true - the system can no longer determine the actual position of the MPA
IP incorrectly remains true even after movement - the system falsely believes the MPA is still at initial position, despite it having moved
IP remains true - no movement has occurred / the axis is stuck
diagnoses: MPA is stuck -> does not move besides being commanded to.

fault_scenarios.description: WP remains true - no movement has occurred
diagnoses: MPA is stuck = does not move besides being commanded to.

                        alarm 701125 is triggered.

Measuring probe both end position sensors active alarm triggers a warning with stacklight.
